en.topic_title: Mid-Autumn Festival: Inaugural Int’l Lantern Spectacular opens Thurs in Victoria Park
en.topic_summary:
Causeway Bay’s Victoria Park will be transformed into a global showcase of lantern crafts from Thursday to mark the upcoming Mid-Autumn Festival.



An artist’s impression of the upcoming International Lantern Spectacular in Victoria Park, Causeway Bay from September 17, 2026. Photo: HKTB.



The inaugural International Lantern Spectacular, organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB), will be free to enter and will run until September 27.
